title: The digital identity breach
body: A premium lifestyle platform you depend on is breached: the purchase histories and private profiles of 40,000 high-net-worth clients leak. Several cancel their memberships and the press names your brand.

title: The experience economy disruption
body: A disruptive startup offers ultra-personalised premium experiences without ownership. 20% of your clients shift spending to it within a quarter and engagement with your products falls.

title: The counterfeit revolution
body: Hyper-realistic counterfeits made with advanced manufacturing flood the market. Even experts cannot tell them apart; resale prices of authentic pieces fall 30% and returns from buyers who fear fakes rise 4×.

title: The luxury market crash
body: A sudden downturn cuts discretionary spending: luxury retail falls 18%, high-end hospitality bookings 25% and luxury real estate deals 30%. Your next funding round is postponed.

title: Heatwave breaks the cold chain
body: A 46°C heatwave hits North India. Your cold chain fails in 3 cities: 18% of this week's stock spoils and 2,400 customers post complaints. Refunds cost Rs 41 lakh.

title: A giant gives it away free
body: A quick-commerce giant launches a free version of your core product or service for its partners. 22% of your customers say they will switch within a month.

title: Fake sustainability data
body: A journalist shows that a key supplier faked its 'plastic-free' and 'organic' data, which you printed on your packs. #Greenwashing trends with your name in it.

title: Raw materials up 30%
body: Palm oil, packaging and fuel costs rise 30% in a quarter. Your gross margin falls from 34% to 21%, and your next funding round is now in doubt.

title: Grid blackout in peak summer
body: A 9-hour blackout across 4 states. Your systems or stations go offline, 30% of customers miss service, and penalty clauses cost Rs 55 lakh.

title: Cheap imports flood the market
body: Solar panels and batteries from abroad drop 25% in price. Your hardware now costs more than rivals' and two big orders are cancelled.

title: A battery fire goes viral
body: A video of a battery fire at a customer site gets 4 million views. The fire was not proven to be yours, but bookings fall 40% and a regulator asks for safety data.

title: Subsidy cut overnight
body: The government cuts the subsidy your customers rely on from Rs 30,000 to Rs 10,000. Your payback pitch of 4 years becomes 6.5 years.
